thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm handing off ownership of the `model-flags` ConfigMap to infra for the next 2-week rollout. PR is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1894. Main asks: 1) confirm TF changes (remote state?) 2) validate k8s patch and kustomize overlay 3) secret sync for per-model overrides (not storing creds in CM). Plan is canary in eu-west, then widen.
kevin: thanks — saw the PR. main TF change is adding a k8s_manifest resource and updating the `infra-configs` module. remote state stays the same (s3/lock). I left notes in the PR about locking the apply window.
anya: quick Q — how are we modeling per-model overrides? is it multiple keys in one ConfigMap or separate per-model ConfigMaps?
maria: currently one ConfigMap `model-flags` with keys like `gptq_enabled:modelA=true` — agreed this is messy. proposal in PR: move to per-model submaps via JSON values, e.g. `modelA: {"flags": {...}}`. avoids exploding number of resources.
sam: JSON-in-configmap is fine but watch size limits and line noise. alternative: keep lightweight flags in CM and put larger configs in a `model-configs` Secret (encrypted) with a link in the CM.
kevin: for secrets wiring: Terraform will create a sealed secret in the `configs` namespace and we sync to clusters with the secret-sync controller. confirm that we should not put opaque secrets directly in the CM.
maria: correct — no secrets in CM. only non-sensitive knobs. we will use sealed secret + secret-sync. I've added a checklist in the PR description.
infra-ci: deploy-bot: new canary deployment created for namespace `eu-west-1/prod` (job id: deploy-4923). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/deploy-4923
kevin: maria — can you add a tiny kustomize overlay for the canary? I'll run the apply during our 1-hour window. example patch I put in the PR:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: model-flags
data:
  modelA.json: |
    {"flags":{"gptq":true,"batching":false}}
```
maria: done — added `overlays/canary/model-flags-patch.yaml` and flagged the apply window in the PR. Also added a smoke test plan: 1) deploy canary 2) run 100 inference requests against modelA 3) check latency & error-rate 4) if OK, promote.
anya: who owns the rollback steps if the canary fails?
sam: infra owns the rollback (revert k8s manifest + scale down canary). i'll own runbook doc and be on pager during the window.
kevin: one more ask — please include a test to validate that secret-sync actually projects the secret into `configs` namespace before canary. we had a hiccup last time where sync lagged ~2m. a small wait/retry in CI is fine.
maria: noted. added `wait_for_secret` step to the pipeline in the PR.
deploy-bot: I added :thumbsup: reaction on the PR and queued the canary apply for 2026-04-01T18:00Z.
kevin: LGTM from infra side, will review final small comments and apply during window.
maria: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the handoff log — ping me here if anything blocks the apply. :raised_hands:
